Egg yolk appears in a veterinary diagnostic laboratory context. It supplies no oral poached-egg exposure, human population or Parkinson falls outcome.
Chicken dust is named as an inhaled exposure in equine respiratory hypersensitivity. The chapter supplies no poached chicken or fatigue outcome.
Some cattle cases grazed among several forages including kale. It is a feed context with no isolated kale exposure and a respiratory outcome instead of falls.
Barley appears in the cattle-rearing setting and as straw bedding. Straw is a different plant part and route, with no boiled grain or anxiety outcome.

Nineteen women with excess weight completed the three-month olive-leaf-extract pilot (nine extract and ten placebo). Symptoms improved on several within-arm measures in both groups. The authors report no significant effect of leaf extract compared with placebo and identify recruitment shortfall. Leaf extract differs from cold-pressed oil. No participant population with Parkinson disease was studied.
